title: Databases in priority order
summary: A file several databases list takes its command from the first one, and the others stay on offer as contexts
prose: Database `a` lists `main.cpp` with `-DFROM_A`; database `b` lists it with `-DFROM_B` and also lists `other.cpp`. `main.cpp` compiles with the command from `a` and can be switched to the one from `b`, while `other.cpp` takes its command from `b`.

files.text:
#ifndef FROM_A
#error missing FROM_A
#endif
int main() { return 0; }

#ifndef FROM_B
#error missing FROM_B
#endif
int other() { return 0; }
